LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_HitchGizmoDesc: Choose a trailer, or a vehicle to tow home on the tow bar, standing within {CELLS} cells. A colonist walks over and couples it, and it is set straight behind this vehicle. Its weight, and everything in it, then adds to the weight the engine must pull.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_WinchGizmoDesc: Choose a stuck, broken or empty vehicle within {CELLS} cells. With someone aboard to work it, the winch drags it towards this vehicle a little at a time. The winch pulls up to {RATED} kg, but never more than this vehicle can hold on its brakes: a heavy vehicle in deep mud may be too much for it.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_StopWinchGizmoDesc: Stop pulling {TOWED}. It stays where it is now.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_NotATrailerNoWinch: {TOWED} is not a trailer. A vehicle with a recovery winch fitted can tow it on its tow bar.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_NoAircraft: {TOWED} is an aircraft: it cannot be towed or winched.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_LandOnly: Only a land vehicle can be towed or winched, and {TOWED} is not one.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_EngineOn: {TOWED} is ready to drive. Undraft it so it rolls free behind the tow bar.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_TowingSomething: {TOWED} is towing or winching something itself. Let that go first.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_TooHeavyToTow: {TOWED} weighs {WEIGHT} kg: too much for {TRACTOR} to tow, which can take up to {LIMIT} kg. Send a heavier vehicle.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_WinchBusy: {TRACTOR} is winching {TOWED}. Stop the winch first.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_UnhitchFirst: {TRACTOR} is towing {TOWED}. Unhitch it before using the winch.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_WaitingToHitch: {TRACTOR} is waiting for someone to couple {TOWED}.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_NobodyAboard: Nobody is aboard {TRACTOR} to work the winch.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_NotOurs: {TOWED} is not ours. Claim it first.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_TooFar: {TOWED} is too far away for the winch rope. Park within {CELLS} cells of it.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_TooHeavyToPull: Moving {TOWED} where it stands takes a pull of {REQUIRED} kg, and {TRACTOR} can give only {AVAILABLE} kg here. Firmer ground under either vehicle, a heavier winching vehicle or a lighter load would help.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_WinchStarted: {TRACTOR} starts winching {TOWED} in: it takes {REQUIRED} kg of the {AVAILABLE} kg the winch can give here.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_WinchStalled: The winch on {TRACTOR} has stalled: moving {TOWED} now takes {REQUIRED} kg, more than the {AVAILABLE} kg it can give here.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_WinchBlocked: The winch on {TRACTOR} has stopped: something is in the way of {TOWED}.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_StoppedTractorMoved: The winch on {TRACTOR} has stopped: it drove off while pulling {TOWED}.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_StoppedTowedMoved: The winch on {TRACTOR} has stopped: {TOWED} drove off.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_StoppedNobodyAboard: The winch on {TRACTOR} has stopped: nobody is left aboard to work it, and {TOWED} stays where it is.
LanguageData.PhobosRecovery_InspectWinching: Winching {TOWED} in: {CELLS} cells to go, pulling {REQUIRED} of {AVAILABLE} kg.
